paragraphs: Minyamin, a Tanna of a baraita.

At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:2 they ask, “How long is the interval of seclusion?” Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira says—Rabbi Elazar—Minyamin says, “Enough time for her to extend her hand,” etc. Sotah 4a attributes the ruling to Chanin ben Pinchas.

notes.text: The dashes abbreviate intervening opinions. Jerusalem Talmud Sotah1:2 explicitly names Yehudah ben Beteira and Elazar ben Pinchas before Minyamin’s view. The notice quotes only part of the hand-extension measure.
